SELECT 'closure' k, CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR) a, CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR) b, closure_type c, CAST(weeks_closed AS VARCHAR) d, '' e FROM ref_store_closure WHERE store_id=102
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lines', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(min(sale_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(max(sale_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS VARCHAR)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dups', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR), CAST(sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT channel_code) AS VARCHAR)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL

SELECT sale_date, count(*) n, sum(quantity) u FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-05' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (
  SELECT p.sku, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.channel_code, f.sales_line_id, f.product_key
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE st.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
), r AS (
  SELECT s.sku, sum(rl.quantity_returned) ret FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN s ON s.sales_line_id=rl.sales_line_id GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.sku, max(p.product_name) name, count(DISTINCT s.product_key) versions, sum(s.quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE quantity END) units_ex_staff, coalesce(max(r.ret),0) returned
FROM s JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=s.product_key LEFT JOIN r ON r.sku=s.sku
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold, count(*) AS n_lines, max(f.quantity) AS max_line_qty, min(f.sale_date) AS first_d, max(f.sale_date) AS last_d, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE st.store_id = 102
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.sku
LIMIT 4
